checkRuns.command: grep -rl '\$lib/' src | xargs sed -i "s#\$lib/#\#lib/#g"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -8; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3

sed -i 's#"\#lib/\*": "./src/lib/\*"#"\#lib/assets/*": "./src/lib/assets/*",\n\t\t"\#lib/*": "./src/lib/*.ts"#' package.json; grep -A4 imports package.json; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -8; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3

(PORT=4799 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4799 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/pid); sleep 2
P="curl -s -X POST -H Accept:text/html -H Origin:http://localhost:4799"
$P -d 'name=+A+&email=x&message=hi' localhost:4799/contact | grep -o 'class="error[^<]*<\|value="[^"]*"\|<textarea.*</textarea>'
$P -d 'name=+A+&email=a@b.co&message=hello+hello+hello+hello' localhost:4799/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*'
kill $(cat /tmp/pid); sleep 1; curl -s localhost:4799 >/dev/null && echo STILL UP; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short
